title: Trajectory Aerodynamics, Approach Angles (VAA/HAA) & Whiff Lift
summary: Derived full-population terminal flight velocities at y=1.417 ft, VAA, HAA, plate_x_norm, and attack zones over 14.64M pitches in DuckDB. Proved flat VAA (VAA_diff > +1.5 deg) produces +52% relative lift in Four-Seam fastball whiff rate.
hypotheses: Approach angles (VAA/HAA) provide orthogonal predictive information to raw velocity and IVB.
Four-seam fastballs entering high with flatter VAA than expected produce non-linear whiff lift due to batter perceptual motor error.

formulas.plate_x_norm: plate_x * (case when stand = 'L' then -1.0 else 1.0 end)

title: 4-Quadrant Platoon Physics, Break Symmetry & Situational Pitching Effectiveness
summary: Quantified full-population pitching mechanics across RvR, RvL, LvL, and LvR using Silver v_statcast_features. Established Batter-Perspective Horizontal Break (hb_away_in) as the physical driver of platoon splits: glove-side breaking pitches (ST/SL) lose 4.9-7.5 pct whiff and ~2-3 pct CSW against opposite-hand batters while offspeed (CH/FS) inverts the edge. Derived Pitcher Platoon Vulnerability Index (PVI) and verified out-of-time stability (r = 0.885).
hypotheses: Platoon splits are physically driven by horizontal break direction relative to the batter (hb_away_in), not merely pitcher handedness.
Evaluating pitchers on CSW%, xwOBA, and RV/100 prevents undervaluing ground-ball sinkers (SI) that generate low whiffs.
Pitchers lacking an opposite-hand offspeed weapon exhibit elevated PVI and suffer amplified 3rd-TTO xwOBA degradation.

formulas.hb_glove_in: hb_in * (CASE WHEN p_throws = 'L' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)
formulas.hb_away_in: hb_in * (CASE WHEN stand = 'L' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)

title: Commit-Point Pitch Tunneling & Platoon-Conditioned Stuff+ / Location+ / Pitching+
summary: Materialized exact y0=50ft -> y=23.8ft commit-point pitch tunneling across all 19 seasons (10,201,496 consecutive pairs, strictly sorted ADR-001 ZSTD Parquet, 0 bad rows, 0 inversions) and trained strictly chronological Regular-Season (game_type='R') xgboost hist Stuff+, orthogonal Location+, Pitching+, and Pitching+Tunnel models over 2015-2026. All tree models beat empirical and analytical Ridge baselines on locked 2025-2026 run value and swing-and-miss whiff deception; mlbr Stuff+ hits split-half r = 0.975 in 100 regular-season pitches (vs. 0.078 for Raw RV/100), achieves YoY r = 0.878 (vs. ERA r = 0.188), and correlates at r = 0.817 with FanGraphs Pitching+.
hypotheses: Reconstructing exact (x50, z50) from (plate_x, plate_z) eliminates the 2.87 in mean (4.69 in p95) naive release-point commit-point tunneling error.

Non-linear gradient boosted trees (xgboost hist) over platoon-normalized aerodynamics and fastball differentials strictly outperform empirical and linear Ridge baselines on locked 2025-2026 regular-season run value.
Commit-point pitch tunneling features add measurable out-of-sample lift to swing-and-miss deception (Whiff Log-Loss & ROC AUC on paired swings) and next-season pitcher SIERA/FIP forecasting.
Physics-based Stuff+ stabilizes to true-talent signal in 50-100 regular-season pitches and predicts next-season K% and SIERA more reliably than lagging ERA.

title: Context-Neutral Markov Decomposed Pitching+ & Pitch-Level Batter Process Engine (Decision+, BatControl+, Contact+)
summary: Replaced single-head raw delta_run_exp regression with a strictly chronological 5-head Markov probability decomposition (p_swing, p_cstr|take, p_whiff|swing, p_foul|contact, E[xwOBA|BIP]) priced via 2015-2023 context-neutral 12-count linear weights. Decomp Pitching+ beat Study 03 Pitching+ on locked 2024->2025 SIERA (-0.5040 vs -0.4984), Hawk-Eye 2020-2023 beat 2015-2023 on all 5 pitch-level validation heads, and pitch-level Batter Decision+ achieved r=0.8464 YoY stability and r=+0.5583 forecasting 2025 BB% (crushing Z-O% proxy +0.3994).
hypotheses: Decomposing pitch value into 5 probability heads priced by context-neutral 12-count linear weights eliminates base-out delta_run_exp variance and improves locked 2024->2025 SIERA forecasting over Study 03.
Feeding v_statcast_tunneling into p_swing and p_whiff|swing improves validation logloss and Pitching+Tunnel validity.
Hawk-Eye 2020-2023 Decomp Stuff+ ablation tests tracking-era homogeneity vs. 2015-2023 full volume.
Pitch-level Decision+, BatControl+, and Contact+ outperform aggregate Z-O% and raw wOBA on stability and component forecasting.

formulas.bip_rv_map: delta_run_exp ~ factor(count_id) + 0.8593 * xwoba (fit strictly on 2015-2023 BIPs)
formulas.ev_swing: p_wh * rv_strike(b,s) + (1 - p_wh) * (p_fl * rv_foul(b,s) + (1 - p_fl) * rv_bip(b,s,xwoba_hat))

title: Hawk-Eye Bat-Tracking (1.15M Swings) & Pitcher Arm-Slot (arm_angle) Biomechanics
summary: Extracted full-population Hawk-Eye bat-tracking biomechanics (2023-2026 competitive swings >= 60 mph) and pitcher release arm_angle (2020-2026 4-seam fastballs). Proved biomechanical process sensors (arm_angle r=0.963, bat_speed r=0.923, swing_length r=0.928) vastly outperform outcome stats in YoY stability, reduce locked 2025 OOS ISO RMSE (0.0444 -> 0.0427) and wOBA RMSE (0.0317 -> 0.0312), and improve OOS 4-seam Whiff% AUC (0.5615 -> 0.5917).
hypotheses: Hawk-Eye biomechanical sensors (bat_speed, swing_length, arm_angle) exhibit YoY reliability r > 0.90, vastly exceeding outcome stats (wOBA, ISO, BABIP).
Adding 2024 bat_speed, blast_rate, and swing_length to prior-year ISO/wOBA improves locked 2025 OOS weighted RMSE.
Pitcher arm_angle and pre-test slot-adjusted ride (ivb_above_slot) improve locked 2024-2025 OOS 4-seam fastball Whiff% Log-Loss and AUC over velocity + raw IVB.

title: Pitch Sequencing, First-Order Markov Transitions, Eye-Level Shifts & Pitcher Shannon Entropy (Seq+)
summary: Quantified full-population Markov pitch-group transitions, 2D eye-level shift (delta_z x delta_velo) whiff surfaces, and count-conditioned pitch-mix Shannon Entropy (2024->2025 YoY r = 0.8428) across 5.6M+ regular-season consecutive pitch pairs (2015-2025). Trained strictly chronological xgboost hist models (2020-2023 -> 2024 val -> locked 2025 OOS n = 279640 paired swings): adding sequencing, eye-level shifts, tunneling, and prior-season entropy strictly beat single-pitch physics+location+count on locked 2025 Whiff Log-Loss (0.46171 -> 0.46091), Brier (0.14813 -> 0.14782), and ROC AUC (0.7694 -> 0.7709), yielding pitcher Sequence+ (Seq+, YoY r = 0.5936).
hypotheses: Multi-pitch sequencing (repeat penalty, vertical eye-level shift delta_z, velocity shift delta_velo, commit-point tunneling, and count-conditioned Shannon entropy) adds measurable OOS whiff deception above single-pitch aerodynamics, location, and count.
Pitcher count-conditioned Shannon entropy H(P|Count) and Sequence+ (Seq+) are stable, repeatable pitcher traits across consecutive seasons.

formulas.eye_level_shift: delta_plate_z = plate_z_N - plate_z_{N-1}; delta_velo_mph = velo_N - velo_{N-1}

title: Chronological True-Talent Player Projections: Marcel, Delta-Method Aging & Tier 1 Physics Priors
summary: Built audit-hardened Tier 2 chronological true-talent projection engine for MLB pitchers and batters across 2002-2027 (10-year rolling Tango Marcel vs. Midpoint Delta-Method Aging 2016-2025, 7-year Statcast Physics 2019-2025, locked 2024->2025 FanGraphs OOS with Stage-2 Residual mlbr Stuff+ and Hawk-Eye Bat Tracking, and secondary 2025->2026 Regular-Season Statcast OOS). Introduced Pulled Air-Ball%, Zone-Chase Selectivity (Z-O Swing%, SEAGER-inspired proxy), Sweet-Spot%, Fastball Velocity Momentum, sum-before-shrink seasonal PVI, and exposure-calibrated 80% uncertainty bands.
hypotheses: Era-adjusted sum-before-divide Tango Marcel with component-specific pre-2016 reliability M strictly beats naive prior-year persistence across every pitching and batting metric.

Midpoint harmonic-mean Delta-Method aging curves eliminate cross-sectional veteran survivorship bias and expose true post-30 biological decline (though Tango's damped piecewise-linear age adjustment remains competitive standalone, while Delta-Method aging feeds Stage-1 M4 cleanly).

Blending Marcel+Aging with strictly chronological Tier 1 Statcast Physics (mlbr Stuff+/Location+/Pitching+, seasonal PVI, Pulled Air%, EV90, Zone-Chase Selectivity) yields statistically significant out-of-sample weighted RMSE reduction on locked 2025 and 2026 outcomes.
Exposure-calibrated residual variance models produce well-calibrated ~80% projection uncertainty bands for downstream Level 4 Monte Carlo game simulation.

formulas.marcel_rate_shrinkage: mu_lg_{T-1,g} + SUM(w_k * N_{T-k} * (r_{T-k} - mu_lg_{T-k,g})) / (SUM(w_k * N_{T-k}) + M_r)
formulas.delta_aging_midpoint: lm(delta ~ ns(age - 0.5, knots = c(24.5, 30.5)), weights = 2*N_{s-1}*N_s/(N_{s-1}+N_s)) + linear boundary extrapolation

title: PECOTA k-NN Similarity Comps, ZiPS Archetype Multi-Year Aging, Defense/Baserunning EDA & 5-Paradigm Consensus Ensemble
summary: Completed Level 2B projection gamut across the full 1960-2025 historical lake (60,591 player-seasons) and 2002-2025 fielding/baserunning EDA (166,850 fielder-seasons). Implemented ZiPS 8/5/4/3 archetype-specific aging & 5-year (2026-2030) career trajectories, vectorized PECOTA k-NN era-neutralized similarity comps (k = 50, p10-p90 percentiles, breakout/collapse/survival probabilities), and a strictly chronological M5 Consensus Meta-Ensemble uniting Marcel, ZiPS, PECOTA, and Statcast Physics.
hypotheses: Defensive (OAA/DRS/UZR) and baserunning (wBsR) skills exhibit markedly lower YoY reliability than plate discipline (K%, BB%), requiring heavier empirical shrinkage.
Position- and role-archetype aging curves (ZiPS 8/5/4/3) capture distinct decay shapes across catchers, up-the-middle athletes, power starters, and relievers.
Era-neutralized PECOTA k-NN similarity matching (1960-2025) yields well-calibrated non-parametric 10th-90th percentile uncertainty fans and explicit attrition/survival probabilities.
A strictly chronological convex meta-ensemble (M5) combining Marcel, ZiPS, PECOTA, and Statcast Physics matches or outperforms every individual projection paradigm out of sample.

formulas.pecota_gaussian_w: w_j = exp(-0.5 * (d_{ij} / tau)^2), top k = 50 comps with season_j <= T - 2
formulas.zips_4yr_weights: 8/5/4/3 recency weighting + archetype midpoint Delta-Method spline aging
formulas.convex_meta_stack: M5 = sum_m w_m * M_m, w_m >= 0, sum(w_m) = 1 (fit strictly on <= T - 1)

title: Empirical Multi-Year Regressed Ballpark Factors & Handedness Asymmetry
summary: Derived 24-year empirical multi-year regressed ballpark factors (2002-2025) across 720 park-seasons using zero-copy DuckDB queries on v_retrosheet_games and v_retrosheet_plays (16.2M+ plate appearances with BAT_EVENT_FL = 'T'). Employs 3-year weighted (3/2/1) rolling window with empirical Bayes shrinkage (M = 40 games for runs, M = 1500 PAs for HR, M = 800 PAs for handedness HR splits, M = 2000 PAs for SO, BB, BABIP). Enriched with physical ballpark geometry, roof type, and elevation.
hypotheses: Single-season park scoring ratios suffer extreme small-sample noise and require 3-year weighted empirical shrinkage (M = 40 games for runs).

Home run environmental factors exhibit sharp batter handedness asymmetry governed by asymmetric outfield fence distances and heights (e.g. Yankee Stadium short porch vs. Oracle Park deep right-center triples alley).
Elevation produces a persistent, non-regressing run and batted-ball trajectory lift (Coors Field ~122 run factor across all eras).

title: Level 3 Team Run Creation (David Smyth BaseRuns), Dynamic Pythagenpat & 10,000-Season 2026 Standings Simulator
summary: Built Level 3 Team Run Creation & Dynamic Standings Engine across 720 historical MLB team-seasons (2002-2025) using exact David Smyth BaseRuns from v_retrosheet_plays, Smyth/Patriot dynamic Pythagenpat exponents, EXP-006 Ballpark Factors, and Level 2 M5 Consensus Player Projections. Executed 10,000 vectorized Monte Carlo simulations over the exact 2026 MLB regular-season schedule to price win distributions and MLB 12-team playoff odds.
hypotheses: David Smyth BaseRuns accurately models non-linear team run creation (r >= 0.96) directly from Retrosheet atomic play components.
Team sequencing/cluster luck (Actual Wins - BaseRuns Pythagenpat Wins) exhibits near-zero year-over-year persistence.
BaseRuns Pythagenpat strictly outperforms prior-year actual win percentage in forecasting next-season (Year T -> T+1) team win percentage.

Combining Level 2 M5 Consensus Projections, EXP-006 Ballpark Factors, and pre-season talent uncertainty yields calibrated 2026 division and playoff probabilities summing strictly to 6 division titles and 12 playoff berths.

formulas.log5_hfa_game_prob: Log5(p_home, p_away) combined with neutral HFA = 0.535

title: Environmental & Officiating Alpha: Weather/Wind Carry, Home-Plate Umpire Strike Zones & Catcher Framing (CSAA)
summary: Quantified environmental carry, home-plate umpire run environments, and catcher framing (CSAA) strictly chronologically. Across 25,640 regular-season MLB games (2015-2025), pre-test (2015-2023) weather carry estimates +0.32 R/G per +10 degF and +0.19 R/G per +10 mph wind out, reducing locked 2024-2025 OOS Totals RMSE on top of EXP-009 from 4.4689 to 4.4598. Across 1.77M called pitches (2021-2025), Catcher Framing CSAA/1000 achieves locked 2024->2025 YoY r = 0.475.
hypotheses: Higher game-time temperature and outfield-blowing wind significantly increase MLB scoring and reduce locked 2024-2025 OOS Total-Runs RMSE on top of EXP-009.
Empirical Bayes home-plate umpire run factors capture persistent zone expansion/compression across veteran umpires.
2D batter-normalized strike-zone Catcher Framing (CSAA) exhibits strong out-of-sample YoY reliability (2024 -> 2025).

formulas.weather_carry: R_env = b0 + b1*PF_runs + b2*(Temp - 70) + b3*WindOut + b4*DayGame
formulas.catcher_framing: CSAA = sum(is_called_strike - p_cs_exp(x, z_norm, stand)); FramingRuns = 0.125 * CSAA

title: Pitcher Stamina, In-Game Fastball Velocity Decay & Dynamic Rolling Bullpen Fatigue Engine
summary: Quantified in-game starting pitcher fastball velocity decay across pitch counts (2018-2025) and built a zero-leakage daily rolling 3-day bullpen workload fatigue engine (n=35812 team-games). Starters lose -0.37 mph at pitches 81-100 and -0.04 mph at 101+, while taxed bullpens (>180 trailing 3d pitches) allow significantly more late-inning runs than rested pens (2.02 vs 1.95 R/G).
hypotheses: Starting pitcher fastball velocity decays through pitch 80 (-0.43 mph), while survivorship masks velocity past pitch 100 even as Run Value/100 degrades.
Clubs entering a game with heavily taxed bullpens (>180 trailing 3-day reliever pitches strictly prior to game date) surrender more late-inning (innings 6-9) runs than rested bullpens.

formulas.bp_load_3d: P_3d(c, t) = sum_{d in [t-3, t-1]} reliever_pitches(c, d)

title: Starter Rest-Day Recovery, Post-IL Return Pitch-Count/Velocity Ramp & Circadian Travel Jet-Lag
summary: Analyzed 35812 uncensored MLB regular-season starts (2018-2025) and 51264 team-games (2015-2025) with exact Haversine travel miles and circadian time-zone shifts. Within-pitcher fixed effects reveal 6d extra rest shifts fastball velocity by -0.01 mph (while IL Return #1 spikes +0.14 mph), while IL Return #1 (15+d layoff, n=1346) incurs a massive -8.8-pitch (-2.15 BF) leash deficit that persists into Start #2 (-2.0 pitches). On locked 2024-2025 OOS IL-return starts (n=414), adding causal rest/IL flags slashed BF RMSE 5.6950 -> 4.8529 and SO RMSE 2.2162 -> 2.0543. Controlled circadian travel analysis (2015-2023) quantified Eastward 2h+ No-Rest at -0.084 R/G (p=0.7444) and Westward 2h+ No-Rest at -0.302 R/G (p=0.1222).
hypotheses: Uncensored starter outings reveal a multi-start post-IL pitch-count leash (Start #1 and #2 back) that dramatically improves locked 2024-2025 OOS BF and SO RMSE on IL-return starts.
6-day extra rest yields positive within-pitcher fastball velocity recovery relative to 5-day normal rest, while cross-country eastward travel without an off-day exhibits measurable circadian drag.

title: Level 4 Plate-Appearance 24 Base-Out Markov Game Simulator & Empirical Win Expectancy Engine
summary: Built Level 4 Plate-Appearance Markov Chain Game Simulator using exact empirical 24 base-out transition tensors (2015-2023 Retrosheet, zero test leakage), multi-category Log5 matchup pricing, starter TTO stamina penalties, bullpen hand-off, extra-inning ghost-runner resolution, and EXP-006 Ballpark Factors. Backtested strictly out-of-sample across all 2024-2025 regular-season MLB games (n = 4859) with empirical Win Expectancy (WE) & WPA trajectories.
hypotheses: Exact 24 base-out Markov half-inning convolution with starter TTO fatigue, bullpen hand-off, and EXP-006 park factors beats coin-flip and home-field baselines on out-of-sample Brier score and Log-Loss.
Pre-game simulated win probabilities exhibit well-calibrated decile reliability slopes near 1.0 across 2024-2025 regular-season games.
Empirical Win Expectancy across 2002-2023 Retrosheet plays yields clean live WPA trajectories for downstream Level 5 in-game market pricing.

formulas.markov_absorption: P(runs = 0..12) via exact 24 base-out transition tensor propagation
formulas.extra_innings_tie: P(Home Win | Tie) = P(H > A | ghost_2B) / (P(H > A) + P(A > H))

title: Live In-Game Bayesian Win Probability, Pre-Game Prior Decay & Real-Time Leverage Index
summary: Built a strictly leak-free 2015-2023 empirical RE24 base Win Expectancy & Tango Leverage Index (LI) matrix (10080 states, 1,615,077 plays, mean |Delta WE| = 0.0354) and trained a dynamic Bayesian log-odds live win-probability engine on 2024 (188,937 plays, 2429 games) validated OOS on locked 2025 (189,311 plays, 2430 games). Optimal 2024 profile-MLE prior-decay exponent gamma* = 0.15 (f_rem^gamma * logit(p_m6_ml)). On locked 2025 plays, winning M2 Bayesian Decayed-Prior cut Brier 0.15592 -> 0.15503 (-0.00089), Log-Loss 0.46438 -> 0.46283 (-0.00155), and lifted ROC AUC 0.85109 -> 0.85351 vs Static RE24 WE (M0), outperforming both M1 Flat Prior (Brier 0.15506, Log-Loss 0.46295) and M3 Full Context (Brier 0.15530).
hypotheses: Inning-decayed Bayesian log-odds updating (f_rem^gamma * logit(p_m6_ml)) strictly beats static RE24 Win Expectancy and non-decayed flat priors on locked 2025 play-by-play Brier and Log-Loss.
Run-environment lead compression (exp_total_m6 x score_diff) and late-inning bullpen fatigue add measurable live-game calibration beyond static score/base-out states.

title: Level 5 Market Edge, Closing Line Value (CLV), Fractional Kelly Bankroll Optimization & Prediction Market Valuation
summary: Completed Level 5 Quantitative Market Valuation Engine. Calibrated a strictly chronological fair-value blend (w_M3=0.453, w_M4=0.547) on 2024 (n=2429) and evaluated strictly out-of-sample on locked 2025 (n=2430) against vig-adjusted sportsbook (-105, 2.38% vig) and prediction-market exchange (-102, 1.00% fee) benchmarks across 4 staking regimes (Flat 1u, Full/Quarter/Eighth Kelly) and 4 EV thresholds (+1%..+5%). Priced all 30 MLB clubs for 2026 Win-Total, Playoff, and World Series futures and audited live archived Polymarket/Kalshi orderbook overround and spreads.
hypotheses: A chronologically calibrated Level 4 blend (M3 Starter+Team Log5 + M4 24 Base-Out Markov) improves locked 2025 OOS ROC AUC and calibration slope (1.043 vs 1.323) over the prior-year Pythagorean baseline, while M3 leads raw Brier and Log-Loss.
Quarter-Kelly (c=0.25) and Eighth-Kelly (c=0.125) bankroll sizing preserve positive long-run log-growth while sharply compressing maximum drawdown relative to Full Kelly (c=1.0).

Live prediction market futures (Polymarket archived WS orderbook) exhibit measurable overround (>100% sum of mids) and bid-ask spread drag that must be explicitly overcome before sizing positive-EV allocations.

title: Unified Pro Multi-Market Engine (Full-Game ML, F5 ML, Totals) & Exact 12-Team MLB Playoff Bracket Simulator
summary: Integrated EXP-011 starter arm-slot ride (prior season), EXP-012 game-time weather/umpire carry, and EXP-013 zero-leakage rolling 3-day bullpen fatigue into a unified chronological multi-market engine (2024 train -> locked 2025 OOS, n=2,430). Improved locked 2025 Full-Game ML Brier (0.2445 -> 0.2444), matched M4 on F5 ML Brier (0.2436 vs 0.2435 with 0.5846 AUC) and improved Total-Runs RMSE (4.5862 -> 4.5744), and simulated 50,000 exact 12-team MLB playoff brackets (AL/NL top-2 byes, Bo3/Bo5/Bo7 Log5 series).
hypotheses: Integrating starter arm-slot ride, weather/umpire carry, and rolling 3-day bullpen fatigue improves locked 2025 OOS Brier/RMSE across Full-Game ML, F5 ML, and Totals.
An exact 12-team MLB playoff bracket simulator with AL/NL top-2 first-round byes preserves exact AL/NL pennant (=1.000), bye (=4.000), and WS (=1.000) probability sums.

formulas.unified_ml: logit(p_ML) = b0 + b1*logit(p_M3) + b2*logit(p_M4) + b3*Delta_IVB_slot + b4*Delta_BP_fatigue
formulas.unified_totals: T_hat = g0 + g1*T_EXP009 + g2*Delta_R_weather + g3*Delta_R_ump + g4*Total_BP_fatigue

title: Daily 9-Man Starting Lineups, Handedness Park Asymmetry & Starting Pitcher Strikeout (SO) Prop Pricing Engine
summary: Extracted exact 9-man starting batting orders (89,118 lineup slots) and realized starter strikeouts across all 2024-2025 regular-season MLB games with strictly prior-season (season-1) EB batter/pitcher priors, EXP-006 handedness park factors, EXP-011 arm-slot ride, EXP-012 umpire K-factors & catcher framing. Locked 2025 OOS Poisson K-Prop engine (n=4859 starts) reduced Strikeout RMSE from 2.4703 -> 2.3285 and achieved Over 5.5 K Brier 0.2129 (AUC 0.6638), while 9-man prior-year lineup wOBA was flat on Full-Game ML Brier (0.24471 vs 0.24435), confirming lineup alpha concentrates sharply in player strikeout props.
hypotheses: Combining prior-season starter K% and BF/GS with exact opposing 9-man starting lineup K%, arm-slot ride, park pf_so, umpire K-factor, and catcher framing beats starter-only and league-mean baselines on locked 2025 OOS Strikeout RMSE, Poisson NLL, and Over 5.5 K Brier/AUC.

Daily 9-man starting lineups and handedness-weighted park factors deliver measurable OOS alpha in player strikeout props (+0.0249 AUC) even where full-game ML Brier is already saturated by team BaseRuns + SP FIP.

formulas.poisson_kprop: log(lambda) = b0 + b1*log(EB_SP_K * EB_BF_GS) + b2*OppLineupK% + b3*IVB_slot + b4*PF_SO + b5*UmpK + b6*CSAA

title: Dynamic In-Season State-Space Talent Updates (30d CSW%, xwOBA, Silver Bat Speed) & Negative Binomial Overdispersed K-Props
summary: Materialized pitch-level Silver statcast_biomechanics (4.55M pitches, 2020-2026) and upgraded EXP-015 Strikeout Props to a Negative Binomial (theta=46.89) Dynamic State-Space model using strictly pre-game (< game_date) trailing 30-day starter CSW% & K%. Across n=4859 locked 2025 regular-season starts, Count NLL dropped 2.2457 -> 2.2416 -> 2.2327, Over 5.5 K AUC rose 0.6638 -> 0.6779, and Over 7.5 K Brier improved 0.11499 -> 0.11333.
hypotheses: MLB starter strikeouts exhibit extra-Poisson overdispersion (Var > Mean), so Negative Binomial (MASS::glm.nb) strictly improves locked 2025 OOS Count NLL and Over 7.5 K tail Brier over Poisson.
Adding strictly pre-game (< game_date) trailing 30-day starter CSW% and K% state-space updates further improves locked 2025 OOS Strikeout RMSE, Count NLL, and Over 5.5 K AUC.

formulas.tail_prob: P(SO > k + 0.5) = 1 - pnbinom(k, size = theta, mu = mu_i)

title: Batter Home Run (HR >= 1) & Total Bases (TB >= 2) Prop Pricing Engine via v_statcast_biomechanics
summary: Registered v_statcast_biomechanics (17th DuckDB view, 4.55M Silver pitches) and built a strictly chronological Batter Home Run & Total Bases Prop Engine (2024 train n=43722 -> locked 2025 OOS n=43740 starting batter-games). Combining Silver bat_speed & Blast Rate with handedness park HR factors (pf_hr_lhb/rhb), game-time temp/wind carry, batting-order slot, platoon, and opposing SP HR% lifted locked-2025 OOS HR>=1 AUC 0.5960 -> 0.6155 (LL 0.35614 -> 0.35303) and TB>=2 AUC 0.5418 -> 0.5695 (LL 0.64849 -> 0.64427).
hypotheses: Integrating Silver bat_speed and Blast Rate with handedness park HR factors, game-time weather/wind carry, batting-order slot, platoon, and opposing SP HR% strictly beats prior-ISO-only and league-mean baselines on locked 2025 OOS Home Run (HR>=1) and Total Bases (TB>=2) Log-Loss and ROC AUC.

formulas.hr_prop_logit: logit(P(HR>=1)) = b0 + b1*EB_ISO + b2*EB_HR + b3*BatSpeed + b4*Blast + b5*Slot + b6*Platoon + b7*PF_HR_hand + b8*Temp + b9*WindOut + b10*OppSP_HR
formulas.tb2_prop_logit: logit(P(TB>=2)) = g0 + g1*EB_SLG + g2*EB_ISO + g3*BatSpeed + g4*Blast + g5*Slot + g6*Platoon + g7*PF_Runs + g8*PF_HR_hand + g9*Temp + g10*WindOut + g11*OppSP_HR

title: Same-Game Parlay (SGP) Correlation Matrix & Gaussian/Clayton Copula Pricing Engine
summary: Quantified exact within-game correlation across all 6 priced MLB markets (Full-Game ML, F5 ML, Totals Over 8.5, NegBin SP K-Props, Batter HR & TB Props) and built a strictly chronological Gaussian & Clayton/90-deg-Rotated Copula SGP Pricing Engine (2024 MLE -> locked 2025 OOS across 8 canonical 2-leg & 3-leg SGP scripts). On locked 2025 OOS, Gaussian Copula slashed Home ML + F5 Home Log-Loss 0.75573 -> 0.68004 (1.56x), Batter HR + Team ML Log-Loss 0.26816 -> 0.26469 (1.29x), Batter TB 2+ + Over 8.5 Log-Loss 0.52080 -> 0.51254 (1.22x), and 3-Leg Home ML + Home TB 2+ + Over 8.5 Log-Loss 0.37783 -> 0.36939 (1.36x).
hypotheses: Within-game MLB market correlations are structurally stable year-over-year (2024 -> 2025) across positive and negative SGP scripts.
Gaussian and Clayton/90-deg-Rotated Copulas fit strictly via 2024 bivariate Bernoulli MLE outperform naive independence on locked 2025 OOS Log-Loss, Brier Score, and pricing calibration.

formulas.sklar_copula: P(Y1=1, Y2=1) = C(p1, p2; psi), constrained by max(0, p1+p2-1) <= C <= min(p1, p2)
formulas.gauss_plackett: C_Gauss(u, v; rho) = u*v + integral_0^rho phi_2(Phi^-1(u), Phi^-1(v); r) dr
formulas.clayton_neg90: C_90(u, v; theta) = v - C_Cl(1 - u, v; theta)

title: Joint Ordered/Multinomial Total Bases Ladder (0-4+ TB) & Exponential Half-Life State-Space Decay
summary: Upgraded EXP-017 to joint 5-class Ordered (MASS::polr) and Multinomial Softmax (nnet::multinom) Total Bases pricing over {0,1,2,3,4+ TB} across 43,740 locked 2025 OOS batter-games with 0 monotonicity violations (5-class NLL 1.45182 -> 1.44285 POLR -> 1.43881 Multinomial; TB>=4 AUC 0.5884 -> 0.6003). Simultaneously benchmarked strictly pre-game exponential half-life decay (H=7,14,21,30d) against EXP-016 flat 30d NegBin K-Props across 4,859 locked 2025 starts: 2024-selected optimal H*=30d achieved locked 2025 Count NLL 2.23027 vs 2.23273 flat 30d (RMSE 2.3002 vs 2.3068).
hypotheses: Joint Ordered and Multinomial Total Bases models guarantee zero monotonicity violations across TB>=1..4 while beating league base rates on 5-class NLL and Ranked Probability Score.
Continuous exponential half-life decay weights improve upon a discontinuous flat 30-day boxcar window for in-season starter CSW% & K% state-space updates.

formulas.ordered_polr: logit(P(TB <= k | x)) = alpha_k - beta'x, k in {0,1,2,3}
formulas.multinom_tb: P(TB = k | x) = exp(gamma_k'x) / sum_m exp(gamma_m'x), P(TB >= k) = sum_{m>=k} P(TB = m)
formulas.exp_halflife: w(dt; H) = 2^(-dt / H), dt = DATEDIFF('day', prev_date, game_date) in [1, 90]

title: Interior Half-Life Sweep, Dynamic In-Season Starter Workload (BF/GS) & Multivariate Copula-Kelly Staking
summary: Resolved EXP-019's boundary half-life sweep (H=14..180d, 2024-selected H*=180d) and added strictly causal in-season starter workload (bf_gs_exp, EB M=4 starts) to NegBin K-Props, lifting locked-2025 OOS (n=4,859) Over 5.5 K AUC 0.6827 -> 0.6854, Count NLL 2.23014 -> 2.22522, and SO RMSE 2.2999 -> 2.2879. Integrated EXP-018's 2024 Gaussian Copula covariance matrix into an exact box-constrained Multivariate Quarter-Kelly sizer across 3 simultaneous same-game markets (ML, Home SP O5.5 K, Over 8.5) on locked 2025 (-105 vig synthetic benchmark): positive-correlation tickets received -8.01% stake haircut and negative-correlation hedges +11.68%, shifting daily vol 7.55% -> 7.50% and Max DD 32.08% -> 33.24%.
hypotheses: Adding strictly causal exponentially-decayed in-season starter workload (BF/GS) to interior half-life CSW%/K% improves locked 2025 OOS NegBin K-Prop Count NLL, RMSE, and Over 5.5 K AUC over EXP-019.
Multivariate Copula-Kelly sizing haircuts positively correlated same-game tickets and preserves/boosts negatively correlated hedges, compressing portfolio volatility and drawdown.
